_readme: Visual styles of the hezb-motion engine. A style makes full videos only when data/approval.json approves it at the current scripts/skill_hash.py fingerprint (owner decision 2026-11-15: approve once per style).

M1.name: Living storybook
M1.look: warm hand-inked world painted with p5.js and paper.js, coloured stick people with faces that act, ambient life (birds, smoke, wind, rain, crowds), physics props, GL transitions, a Tone.js score
M1.use_for: every lane: stories, parables, mysteries (night grade), news explainers (day grade)
